record.name: Fullplan: Travel Companion
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Fullplan is the AI travel companion that knows the world — one app for asking questions, discovering places, planning your trip, and staying safe.

ASK ANYTHING, ANYWHERE
Chat with an AI that knows hundreds of destinations. Get personalized tips on hidden gems, budget tricks, local food, and things most tourists miss — in your own language, any time of day.

8,400+ REAL PLACES ON ONE MAP
Explore museums, viewpoints, monuments, nature spots, beaches, markets and more across dozens of countries. Filter by mood (romantic, budget, family-friendly, adventurous) or category, sort by real distance from where you are, and save your favorites.

AI TRIP PLANNER
Tell Fullplan where you're going and for how long. It builds a day-by-day itinerary — mornings, afternoons, evenings, with practical tips on tickets, transport and local prices — in minutes, not hours.

YOUR OWN TRAVEL CALENDAR
Plan any day independently, save AI-generated itineraries and recommendations straight to your calendar, and keep a private travel journal that never leaves your device.

REAL FLIGHT TRACKING
Enter a flight number and see live status, gate, terminal and delay information — real data, not a guess.

SOS — SAFETY WHEREVER YOU ARE
One tap to the EU emergency number, local ambulance/fire/police numbers, and useful emergency phrases and a translator.

GAMIFIED PROFILE
Earn XP for every place you visit, collect badges, track how many countries and cities you've explored, and see how you compare with friends on the leaderboard.

FAMILY & GROUP TRAVEL
Share your live location with travel companions and see everyone on one map — verified by real GPS, so it's always accurate.

16 LANGUAGES
Fullplan speaks English, Hungarian, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Polish, Dutch, Turkish and Swedish.

PRIVACY-FIRST
Your journal, notes, favorites and personal trip data stay on your device — we don't collect or upload them. No hidden trackers, no ad SDKs.

Whether you're planning your next trip or already on the road, Fullplan is the one app that keeps up with you — plan it all, see it all, do it all.

record.description_evidence:
SkorAI is the SPM study app made for KSSM students. Drill past papers, get instant AI grading on your handwritten work, and chat with subject-specialised tutors that actually know what your exam asks for.

WHAT YOU GET
* Real SPM past papers - KSSM-aligned, every subject we cover
* AI grading with marking-scheme feedback - see exactly which marks you missed and why
* Subject tutors - Math (Quanta), Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Sejarah, BM, English. Ask in any language.
* Daily quests + leagues - turn revision into a streak you actually show up for
* Premium - extended usage, photo and paper grading, every chapter unlocked. Fair-use daily limits apply.

WHY STUDENTS USE SKORAI
* Practice the way you'll sit the exam: real questions, real marking-scheme expectations
* Get feedback in seconds, not 'next class'
* Honest about its limits - every AI result is labelled, and we always tell you to verify with your teacher and the official marking scheme

PRIVACY + SAFETY
* Your work, your account. Delete everything from inside the app in two taps.
* We don't sell your data. Read the full Privacy Policy in-app or at https://skorai.my/privacy.

A NOTE ON AI
SkorAI uses AI to grade and explain. Real SPM examiners are humans and may award marks differently. Use SkorAI's score as a strong practice signal, never as a replacement for your teacher.

Built in Malaysia for SPM. Questions? support@skorai.my
